# Vendored browser libraries

Served from this site (not a CDN) because the site's Content-Security-Policy only allows scripts from itself.

| File | Library | Version | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| gsap.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js | GSAP | 3.15.1 | GSAP Standard "no charge" license, https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| lenis.min.js | Lenis | 1.3.28 | MIT |

To update: `npm i gsap lenis`, copy the three files from `node_modules/gsap/dist/` and `node_modules/lenis/dist/`, and update the versions here.
